children.text: Chapter 1
atha yasyāgnayo mithaḥ saṃsṛjyeran kā tatra prāyaścittiḥ ||
children.translated_text: Now, if someone's fires should become mixed with one another, what is the expiation in that case?

children.text: so 'gnaye vītaye 'ṣṭākapālaṃ puroḍāśaṃ prāṅ nirvapet ||
children.translated_text: He should offer to <s>Agni Vītaye</s> an eight-cup sacrificial cake, setting it out toward the east.

children.text: nityāḥ purastāddhomāḥ ||
children.translated_text: The regular preliminary oblations are to be made.

children.text: saṃsthitahomeṣv agna āyāhi vītaye gṛṇāno havyadātaye ni hotā satsi barhiṣi iti madhyata opya saṃsrāvabhāgaiḥ saṃsthāpayet ||
children.translated_text: When the oblations have been completed, he should insert in the middle, 'O <s>Agni</s>, come for the feast, praised, to give the oblation; sit down as hotṛ on the sacred grass,' and he should complete the rite with the portions from the collected remnants.

children.text: atha yasyāgnayo grāmyeṇāgninā saṃsṛjyeran kā tatra prāyaścittiḥ ||
children.translated_text: Now, if someone's fires should become mixed with a village fire, what is the expiation in that case?

children.text: so 'gnaye vivicaye 'ṣṭākapālaṃ puroḍāśaṃ nirvapet ||
children.translated_text: He should offer to <s>Agni Vivicaye</s> an eight-cup sacrificial cake.

children.text: nityāḥ purastāddhomāḥ ||
children.translated_text: The regular preliminary oblations are to be made.

children.text: saṃsthitahomeṣv agnim īﾱe purohitaṃ viviciṃ ratnadhātamaṃ pra ṇa āyūṃṣi tāriṣat ||
children.translated_text: When the oblations have been completed, he should use: '<s>Agni</s> I praise, the household priest, the discerner, best bestower of treasures; may he carry our lifetimes across.'

children.text: iti madhyata opya saṃsrāvabhāgaiḥ saṃsthāpayet ||
children.translated_text: Having inserted this in the middle, he should complete the rite with the portions from the collected remnants.

children.text: atha yasyāgnayaḥ śāvenāgninā saṃsṛjyeran kā tatra prāyaścittiḥ ||
children.translated_text: Now, if someone's fires should become mixed with fire from a corpse, what is the expiation in that case?

children.text: so 'gnaye śucaye 'ṣṭākapālaṃ puroḍāśaṃ nirvapet ||
children.translated_text: He should offer to <s>Agni Śucaye</s> an eight-cup sacrificial cake.

children.text: nityāḥ purastāddhomāḥ ||
children.translated_text: The regular preliminary oblations are to be made.

children.text: saṃsthitahomeṣv agniḥ śucivratatamaḥ śucir vipraḥ śuciḥ kaviḥ ||
children.translated_text: When the oblations have been completed: '<s>Agni</s>, most pure in vow, pure inspired priest, pure seer,'

children.text: śucī rocata āhutaḥ ||
children.translated_text: 'pure, shines when invoked.'

children.text: ud agne śucayas tava śukrā bhrājanta īrate ||
children.translated_text: 'Upward, O <s>Agni</s>, your pure, bright flames blaze forth.'

children.text: tava jyotīṃṣy arcayaḥ svāheti madhyata opya saṃsrāvabhāgaiḥ saṃsthāpayet ||
children.translated_text: 'Your lights are rays: svāhā.' Having inserted this in the middle, he should complete the rite with the portions from the collected remnants.

children.text: atha yasyāgnayo dāvenāgninā saṃsṛjyeran kā tatra prāyaścittir annādyaṃ vā eṣa yajamānasya saṃvṛjyāvṛta upa to 'raṇyād grāmam adhy abhyupaiti ||
children.translated_text: Now, if someone's fires should become mixed with forest-fire, what is the expiation in that case? This one, having enclosed and hemmed in the sacrificer's food, comes from the wilderness over to the village.

children.text: so 'gnaye 'nnādāyānnapataye 'ṣṭākapālaṃ puroḍāśaṃ nirvapet ||
children.translated_text: He should offer to <s>Agni Annāda Annapati</s>, eater of food and lord of food, an eight-cup sacrificial cake.

children.text: nityāḥ purastāddhomāḥ ||
children.translated_text: The regular preliminary oblations are to be made.

children.text: saṃsthitahomeṣv apaścāddaghvānnasya bhūyāsam ||
children.translated_text: When the oblations have been completed: 'May I be one who eats food, not one left behind.'

children.text: iti madhyata opya saṃsrāvabhāgaiḥ saṃsthāpayet ||
children.translated_text: Having inserted this in the middle, he should complete the rite with the portions from the collected remnants.

children.text: atha yasyāgnayo divyenāgninā saṃsṛjyeran kā tatra prāyaścittiḥ ||
children.translated_text: Now, if someone's fires should become mixed with heavenly fire, what is the expiation in that case?

children.text: so 'gnaye jyotiṣmate 'ṣṭākapālaṃ puroḍāśaṃ nirvapet ||
children.translated_text: He should offer to <s>Agni Jyotiṣmat</s>, possessed of light, an eight-cup sacrificial cake.

children.text: nityāḥ purastāddhomāḥ ||
children.translated_text: The regular preliminary oblations are to be made.

children.text: saṃsthitahomeṣu vidyotate dyotate ||
children.translated_text: When the oblations have been completed: 'It flashes; it shines.'

children.text: vidyuto 'gnir jihvā ||
children.translated_text: 'Lightning is the tongue of <s>Agni</s>.'

children.text: vidyutā bhrājanti dyotata ā ca dyotate ||
children.translated_text: 'They blaze with lightning; it shines and keeps shining.'

children.text: iti madhyata opya saṃsrāvabhāgaiḥ saṃsthāpayet ||
children.translated_text: Having inserted this in the middle, he should complete the rite with the portions from the collected remnants.

children.text: atha yasyāgnayo 'bhiplaveran kā tatra prāyaścittiḥ ||
children.translated_text: Now, if someone's fires should be flooded, what is the expiation in that case?

children.text: so 'gnaye 'psumate 'ṣṭākapālaṃ puroḍāśaṃ nirvapet ||
children.translated_text: He should offer to <s>Agni Apsumant</s>, possessed of waters, an eight-cup sacrificial cake.

children.text: nityāḥ purastāddhomāḥ ||
children.translated_text: The regular preliminary oblations are to be made.

children.text: saṃsthitahomeṣv apām agnis tanūbhiḥ ||
children.translated_text: When the oblations have been completed: '<s>Agni</s> of the waters, with his bodies.'

children.text: iti madhyata opya saṃsrāvabhāgaiḥ saṃsthāpayet ||
children.translated_text: Having inserted this in the middle, he should complete the rite with the portions from the collected remnants.

children.text: atha yady anugatam abhyuddharet kā tatra prāyaścittiḥ ||
children.translated_text: Now, if he should lift up a fire that has gone out, what is the expiation in that case?

children.text: so 'gnaye 'gnimate 'ṣṭākapālaṃ puroḍāśaṃ nirvapet ||
children.translated_text: He should offer to <s>Agni Agnimat</s>, possessed of fire, an eight-cup sacrificial cake.

children.text: nityāḥ purastāddhomāḥ ||
children.translated_text: The regular preliminary oblations are to be made.

children.text: saṃsthitahomeṣu śivau bhavatam adya naḥ agnināgniḥ saṃsṛjyate kavir gṛhapatir yuvā havyavāḍ juhvāsyaḥ tvaṃ hy agne agninā vipro vipreṇa san satā sakhā sakhyā samidhyase ||
children.translated_text: When the oblations have been completed: 'Be gracious to us today, you two. Fire is joined with fire: the inspired one, young householder, oblation-bearer, with the ladle as his mouth. For you, O <s>Agni</s>, kindled by fire, an inspired priest by an inspired priest, as a true friend by friendship, are set ablaze.'

children.text: sa no rāsva suvīryam iti madhyata opyātha saṃsrāvabhāgaiḥ saṃsthāpayet ||
children.translated_text: 'Grant us good heroism.' Having inserted this in the middle, he should then complete the rite with the portions from the collected remnants.

children.text: Chapter 2
sāṃnāyyaṃ yad udbodhayeyuś ced vatsā vāyavyāyā yavāgvā sāṃnāyyaṃ yajeta ||
children.translated_text: If calves should rouse the <s>sāṃnāyya</s> offering, he should sacrifice a barley gruel to <s>Vāyavyā</s> as the <s>sāṃnāyya</s>.

children.text: apy ekasyāṃ dhītāyām adhītā dohayet ||
children.translated_text: Even if one cow has been milked, he should milk one that has already been milked.

children.text: adhītābhiḥ saṃsthāpya dhītānām vatsān apākṛtya śvaḥ sāṃnāyyena yajeta ||
children.translated_text: After completing the rite with cows already milked, and having separated the calves from the milked cows, on the next day he should sacrifice with the <s>sāṃnāyya</s>.

children.text: sāyaṃdohaṃ ced apahareyuḥ prātardohaṃ dvaidhaṃ kṛtvānyatarat sāyaṃdohasthāne kṛtvobhābhyāṃ yajeta ||
children.translated_text: If they should carry off the evening milking, he should divide the morning milking in two, put one part in place of the evening milking, and sacrifice with both.

children.text: prātardohaṃ ced apahareyuḥ sāyaṃdohaṃ dvaidhaṃ kṛtvānyatarat prātardohasthāne kṛtvobhābhyāṃ yajeta ||
children.translated_text: If they should carry off the morning milking, he should divide the evening milking in two, put one part in place of the morning milking, and sacrifice with both.

children.text: ubhau ced duṣyeyātām aindraṃ pañcaśarāvam odanaṃ nirupyāgneyena pracaryaindreṇānupracared uttarām upoṣyato vādobhābhyāṃ yajeta ||
children.translated_text: If both should be spoiled, having offered to <s>Indra</s> a cooked rice dish in five bowls, he should proceed with the one for <s>Agni</s> and afterwards with the one for <s>Indra</s>; or, after fasting the following day, he should sacrifice with both.

children.text: sarvāṇi ceddhavīṃṣy apahareyur duṣyeyur vājyena ca devatā yajeta ||
children.translated_text: If all the oblations should be carried off or spoiled, he should sacrifice to the deity with clarified butter.

children.text: athānyām adoṣām iṣṭiṃ tanvītām apo duṣṭam abhyavahareyuḥ ||
children.translated_text: Then they should perform another unspoiled iṣṭi; they should carry the spoiled one away into the waters.

children.text: brāhmaṇair abhakṣyaṃ duṣṭaṃ haviḥ ||
children.translated_text: A spoiled oblation is not to be eaten by Brāhmaṇas.

children.text: bhūtaṃ ced ājyaṃ skanded bhūpataye svāheti tribhiḥ prādeśair diśo mimāya tad yajamāno devāñ janam agann ity anuṣaṅgaḥ ||
children.translated_text: If clarified butter that has been prepared should spill, with three spans he should measure out the quarters, saying, 'Svāhā to <s>Bhūpati</s>'; the sacrificer has the accompanying formula, 'He has gone to the people of the gods.'

children.text: yajñasya tvā pramayeti catasṛbhiḥ parigṛhṇīyāt ||
children.translated_text: With the four verses beginning 'For the measuring of the sacrifice I take you,' he should enclose it.

children.text: yajñasya tvā pramayonmayābhimayā pratimayā paridadema svāheti ||
children.translated_text: 'For the measuring, uplifting, encompassing, and countermeasuring of the sacrifice, we enclose you: svāhā.'

children.text: anutpūtaṃ ced ājyaṃ skanded vittaṃ prāṇaṃ dadyāt ||
children.translated_text: If unpurified clarified butter should spill, he should give wealth, or life-breath.

children.text: tathotpūtam utpūyamānaṃ ced ghṛtaṃ dadyād athotpūtam utpūyamānaṃ ced ghṛtaṃ prāṇaṃ dadyād devatāntare ced ghṛtam ||
children.translated_text: Likewise, if clarified butter that has been purified and is being purified should spill, he should give ghee; and if purified butter being purified should spill, he should give ghee, or life-breath, if the ghee belongs to another deity.

children.text: āhutilopavyatyāse ||
children.translated_text: In the case of an omission or transposition of oblations,

children.text: tvaṃ no agne sa tvaṃ na iti sarvaprāyaścittaṃ juhuyāt ||
children.translated_text: he should offer the universal expiation with 'You, O <s>Agni</s>, are ours' and 'You, indeed, are ours.'

children.text: tvaṃ no agne varuṇasya vidvān devasya heḍo 'vayāsisīṣṭhāḥ yajiṣṭho vahnitamaḥ śośucāno viśvā dveṣāṃsi pramumugdhy asmat ||
children.translated_text: 'You, O <s>Agni</s>, knowing <s>Varuṇa</s>, avert for us the wrath of the god. Most fit for sacrifice, strongest carrier, shining brightly, release all hatreds from us.'

children.text: sa tvaṃ no agne 'vamo bhavotī nediṣṭho asyā uṣaṣo vyuṣṭau ava yakṣva no varuṇaṃ rarāṇo vīhi mṛḍīkaṃ suhavo na edhi svāhā iti ||
children.translated_text: 'So be for us, O <s>Agni</s>, nearest with help, closest at the dawning of this dawn. Worship <s>Varuṇa</s> for us graciously; bring mercy; be easy to invoke for us. Svāhā.'

children.text: devatāvadāne yājyānuvākyāvyatyāse 'nāmnātaprāyaścittānāṃ vā yady ṛkto 'bhy ābādhaḥ syād bhūr janad iti gārhapatye juhuyāt ||
children.translated_text: In the case of the shifting of the yājyā and anuvākyā in the account of the deities, or of expiations not stated by name, if there should be an obstruction in regard to a ṛc, he should offer in the gārhapatya fire with the formula, 'bhūr janad.'

children.text: yadi yajuṣṭa oṃ bhuvo janad iti dakṣiṇāgnau juhuyāt ||
children.translated_text: If it concerns a yajus, he should offer in the dakṣiṇāgni with, 'oṃ bhuvo janad.'

children.text: yadi sāmata oṃ svar janad ity āhavanīye juhuyāt ||
children.translated_text: If it concerns a sāman, he should offer in the āhavanīya with, 'oṃ svar janad.'

children.text: yady anājñātā brahmata om bhūr bhuvaḥ svar janad om ity āhavanīya eva juhuyād ājyabhāgānte sve devatām āvāhayiṣyan yasyaiva havir niruptaṃ syāt tatontayā yajetājyasyaitāni nirupya ||
children.translated_text: If, unknowingly, it is from the brahman, he should offer in the āhavanīya itself with, 'om bhūr bhuvaḥ svar janad om.' At the end of the ājyabhāgas, when he is about to summon his own deity, with whatever oblation has been assigned, he should sacrifice with the concluding formula, having set out these portions of ghee.

children.text: yadi bhāginīṃ nāvāhayed yatra smaret tatrainām upotthāyāvāhyāvāpasthāne yajeta ||
children.translated_text: If he has not invoked the sharing goddess, then wherever he remembers it, there he should rise toward her, invoke her, and sacrifice at the place of the āvāpa.

children.text: barhiṣi skanne nādriyeta ||
children.translated_text: If the barhis has slipped down, he should pay no attention to it.

children.text: dakṣiṇena ced yajetārddharcāt pratiṣṭhāṃ dadyāt ||
children.translated_text: But if he sacrifices with the southern one, after half a verse he should give the establishment.

children.text: puroḍāśe duḥśrite sarpiṣy annaṃ catuḥśarāvam odanaṃ brāhmaṇebhyo dadyāt ||
children.translated_text: When the puroḍāśa has been badly cooked, he should give to the Brahmins four bowls of boiled rice, food cooked with ghee.

children.text: tatas tam eva punar nirvapet ||
children.translated_text: After that, he should prepare that same offering again.

children.text: puroḍāśe vikṣāme yato 'syākṣāmaḥ syāt tato yajeta ||
children.translated_text: When the puroḍāśa is partly burnt away, he should sacrifice from the part of it that has not been burnt away.

children.text: dveṣyāya taṃ dadyād dakṣiṇāṃ ca ||
children.translated_text: He should give that, along with the dakṣiṇā, to an enemy.

children.text: puroḍāśe sarvakṣāme nirvapaṇaprabhṛtyām udāhṛtya ||
children.translated_text: When the puroḍāśa is completely burnt away, beginning from the preparation, after reciting the prescribed formula, he should proceed.

children.text: kapāle naṣṭa ekahāyanaṃ dadyāt ||
children.translated_text: When a potsherd is lost, he should give a one-year-old animal.

children.text: dhātā dadhātu pituḥ pitānaṣṭo gharmo viśvāyur yato jātas tato 'py avāṃ svāhā iti juhuyāt ||
children.translated_text: He should offer with the formula, 'May <s>Dhātṛ</s> establish; the father of the father; the gharma is lost; of all life; from where it was born, from there may we win it back; svāhā.'

children.text: kapāle bhinne gāyatryā tvā śatākṣarayā saṃdadhāmi iti saṃdhāya dhātā dadhātu ity eva juhuyāt ||
children.translated_text: When a potsherd is broken, he should join it together with, 'With the hundred-syllabled gāyatrī I join you,' and then offer with just, 'May <s>Dhātṛ</s> establish.'

children.text: āgneyam ekakapālaṃ nirvaped āśvinaṃ dvikapālaṃ vaiṣṇavaṃ trikapālaṃ saumyaṃ catuḥkapālaṃ ||
children.translated_text: He should prepare an offering to <s>Agni</s> on one potsherd, one to the <s>Aśvins</s> on two potsherds, one to <s>Viṣṇu</s> on three potsherds, and one to <s>Soma</s> on four potsherds.

children.text: naṣṭe bhinne ca bhārgavo hotā kīṭāvapannaṃ sānnāyyaṃ madhyamena parṇena mahī dyauḥ ity antaḥparidhideśe ninayet ||
children.translated_text: When it is lost or broken, the Bhārgava should be the hotṛ. Sānnāyya into which insects have fallen he should pour out with the middle leaf in the region inside the enclosing-sticks, with the formula beginning 'mahī dyauḥ.'

children.text: mahī dyauḥ pṛthivī ca na imaṃ yajñaṃ mimikṣatāṃ pipṛtāṃ no bharīmabhiḥ svāhā iti ||
children.translated_text: 'Great heaven and earth, do not damage this sacrifice; fill us with your nourishments; svāhā'--so the formula runs.

children.text: prāk prayājebhyo 'ṅgāraṃ barhiṣy adhiṣkanden namas te astv āyate namo astu parāyate namo yatra niṣīdasi ity abhimantryāhaṃ yajñaṃ dadhe nirṛter upasthāt taṃ deveṣu paridadāmi vidvān suprajās tvaṃ śataṃ hi māmadanta iha no devā mahi śarma yacchatety ādāya sahasraśṛṅgaḥ ity anuprahṛtya ||
children.translated_text: Before the prayājas, if an ember has leapt upon the barhis, he should address it with, 'Homage to you as you come near; homage as you go away; homage where you sit.' Taking it up with, 'I set the sacrifice away from the lap of <s>Nirṛti</s>; knowing it, I entrust it among the gods; may you, rich in offspring, gladden me for a hundred years; may the gods grant us great shelter here,' he should cast it after with, 'thousand-horned.'

children.text: mā no mahāntaṃ ||
children.translated_text: 'Do not harm our great one'--

children.text: tvaṃ no agne ||
children.translated_text: 'You, O <s>Agni</s>, for us'--

children.text: somānaṃ svaraṇaṃ kṛṇuhi brahmaṇaspate kakṣīvantaṃ ya auśijaḥ ||
children.translated_text: 'Make <s>Soma</s> a refuge for us, O <s>Brahmaṇaspati</s>, and <s>Kakṣīvant</s>, son of <s>Auśij</s>.'

children.text: sa tvaṃ no 'gne ||
children.translated_text: 'So you, O <s>Agni</s>, for us'--

children.text: vṛṣabhaṃ carṣaṇīnāṃ viśvarūpam adābhyaṃ bṛhaspatiṃ vareṇyaṃ ||
children.translated_text: 'The bull of peoples, manifold in form, unassailable, <s>Bṛhaspati</s>, worthy to be chosen.'

children.text: ud uttamaṃ mumugdhi no vi pāśaṃ madhyamaṃ cṛta avādhamāni bādhata ||
children.translated_text: 'Release from us the uppermost noose; cut away the middle one; drive off the lower bonds.'

children.text: ud uttamaṃ varuṇa ity etābhir juhuyāt ||
children.translated_text: With these verses, beginning 'ud uttamaṃ varuṇa,' he should offer.
